## About
Pristine Landscape Contractor works out of Wilshire Blvd in Beverly Hills, helping neighbors take on the yard projects that feel like too much to handle alone.
We get gardens cleaned up, put in artificial turf, build pergolas and put together landscape plans that fit the way you like your yard to look. Along the way we share ideas and give you an honest take, even when that means telling you a job isn't needed.
Our customers have given us a 5 rating across 82 Google reviews, and some of them keep calling us back for the next project.

## Services
- Artificial turf: We put in artificial turf and can save leftover pieces for you. One customer had their turf in within three days of calling, ahead of a family get together.
- Pergolas: We build pergolas for backyards, including matching a new one to a pergola you already have.
- Small garden: We get small gardens cleaned up when the work feels like too much, and share ideas to make them look their best.
- Landscape design: A detailed plan for your yard, put together with your style in mind.

## FAQ
Q: Can you match a structure I already have?
A: Yes. One customer asked for an exact replica of an existing pergola, and said the new one looks like it was built at the same time.

Q: How do I get my quote?
A: We send your quote and payment details electronically, so you can look things over on your own time.

Q: Will you give me ideas for my yard?
A: We're happy to share recommendations and information to help you think through how to improve your yard.
